findings.location: User Story 2 scenario 3; Edge Cases; FR-010
findings.evidence: FR-010 requires every Code Unit Edge to persist both source and target Code Unit identities, but also requires a relationship whose target is not found in the Repository to remain a future Cross-Repository Resolution candidate. User Story 2 scenario 3 repeats that requirement. No record with nullable target or external endpoint identity is specified, so the missing-target case cannot satisfy the required Code Unit Edge fields or be tested/audited. This also conflicts with the glossary's definition of Cross-Repository Resolution as post-scan matching of unresolved uncertainties to Documents, while FR-017 excludes running it in this story.
findings.correction_outcome: At the specification stage, define the auditable persistence contract for an unresolved structural relationship: either a distinct unresolved-result record outside Code Unit Edges, or an explicitly nullable edge target with the stable provider endpoint metadata and invariants required for later mapping. Align User Story 2 scenario 3, the edge cases, FR-010, and a measurable success criterion with that contract, and state that this story records the candidate only and does not run Cross-Repository Resolution. Do not add an LLM, MCP tool, Worker Agent, or Scan Coordinator.

summary: REVISE. The specification correctly preserves the approved local CodeGraphContext boundary, excludes Worker Agent/LLM/MCP/Scan Coordinator scope, uses the authorised File Identity Hash and Range Confidence decisions, and makes the post-plan Scan-strategy approval gate explicit. However, the missing-target structural-relationship requirement has no implementable, testable persistence contract; a fresh spec-author must correct that before planning.
